text: According to a decommissioning order signed by Harbor Authority director Elian Voss and obtained by The Continental Record, the Sennet Lighthouse was formally retired in 2003, ending 117 years of service on the Graymere coast. The order, dated Sept. 14, 2003, cited structural fatigue in the lantern housing, repeated storm damage and the installation of an automated beacon on a nearby jetty. Maintenance logs reviewed by the newspaper show the last full lamp test took place on Aug. 2, 2003, before the final keeper, Mara Fen, locked the tower on Oct. 1. The stone structure remains standing as a protected maritime landmark under a 2005 preservation statute.
